tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// swa sti/ khyab bdag sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang / sprul pa'i gar mdzad ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /byang sems blo gros byang sems rin po che'i brgyan pa rin chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /nus mthu'i dbang phyug grub thob sha ba ri/ /mkhas grub chen po mai tri gupta dang / /paṇa gos dkar po grub dbang po rgya gar phyag na'i zhabs/ /grub chen ka ma la badzra la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas lnga rig pan chen gos dkar po pa dza ya se na dang / skad gnyis smra ba dar ma yon tan zhabs/ /gangs khrod rdor 'dzin dbang po grags pa'i mtshan/ /'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub rin chen skyob pa dpal bzang po/ /rgyal tsha chos dbang lo tsā mchog ldan zhabs/ /bag ston gzhon tshul bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ /bla chen ngag dbang mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhan chen byang seng sa bzang 'phags pa dang / /rgyal ba'i lung bstan rje btsun e waṃ pa/ /rdo rje 'chang zhes 'gro la rab grags pa'i/ /khyab bdag kun dga' bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang bo go rams pa/ /dkon mchog tshul khrims kun dga' legs pa dang / /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rin chen bkra shis mtshan/ /mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub chen po dpal ldan don grub dang / /gang de'i thugs sras khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'jam mgon bla ma dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang / /khams ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /stong dang lnga brgya rig byed kyis lhag pa'i/ /bcu gnyis 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor lha yis tshogs/ /mchog gsum bstan srung nor lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gus pas gsol btab dge tshogs kyis/

/rgyu rgyud 'dzin mar sdom gsum 'bras skyed par/ /nyes ltung ba mo'i sad kyis ma khyer bar/ /tshogs gnyis lo tog rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i don la blo gros rgyas/ /zab don rim gnyis yid bzhin rin chen nor/ /rtse gcig sgom pa'i byi dor bgyid pa la/ /ltar snang tshe 'di'i rnam g.yengs bzlog tu gsol/ /mthun rkyen rgyal bas bsngags pa kun tshang zhing / /mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i sgrib pa kun bral nas/ /snyan pa'i grags pas chos mthun 'khor bsdus te/ /theg mchog bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /chos kun de bzhin nyid kyis rol par shes/ /kun rdzob snang ba lha yi 'khor lo shar/ /de yang bde stong lhan skyes ye shes su/ /'char ba'i ting 'dzin dam pa bstsal du gsol/ /drod dang spyod pa nye rgyu'i mtshams sbyar te/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don grub rdo rje 'chang / /thob nas mar gyur 'gro rnams srid mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon myur du mngon gyur shog /ces bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bde mchog dril bu pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa// rdo rje 'chang dbang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /dril bu pa dang rus sbal zhabs pad dang / /'bar 'dzin kahna gu hya rnam rgyal zhabs/ /te lo nā ro pha na phing sku mched/ /klog skya mal lo sa chen yab sras gsum/ /sa skya paṇa chen bo dong rin chen sogs/ /khro phu bsod seng yang rtse rin chen seng / /bu ston chen po mkhas grub khyung lhas pa/ /shar chen ye rgyal ngor chen kun dga'i mtshan/ /mus chen dkon rgyal sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs/ /sems dpa' chos grags she'u lo tsā ba/ /kun dga' rnam rgyal mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang / /ngag dbang lhun grub rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang bcom ldan 'das/

/bde mchog 'khor lo gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /smin byed dbang gis sku bzhi'i sa bon btab/ /grol byed bskyed rdzogs lam gyi ye shes kyi/ /lus rten 'di nyid sku bzhir mngon gyur mdzod/ /lam bzang bsgrub la mi mthun nyer 'tshe bral/ /mthun rkyen rgyal bas bsngags pa kun tshang nas/ /rang gzhan phan bde'i sgo 'phar brgya 'byed pa'i/ /bkra shis dpal gyi myur du 'byor par shog /ces bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi bla brgyud kha 'don nyung ngu zhig dgos zhes bla ma dpal ldan rin chen gyis bskul nas bya bral bas shugs 'byung du bris pa lags/ maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa// rdo rje 'chang dang gshin rje'i gshed/ sogs nas/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa dang / zhes pa'i bar 'phrin las char 'bebs kyi nang mchod 'bul skabs deng sang gi ngag 'don tshigs bcad ma bzhin brjod/ de nas/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge dang / /'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs/ /rje btsun sangs rgyas seng ge dang / /mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan pa/ /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang dang / /byams pa kun dga' bkra shis zhabs/ /mkhas grub dpal ldan don 'grub dang / /shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs/ /rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang dang / /mtshungs med dam chos bsam grub sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs dang / /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /nges 'byung skyo shas skye ba dang / /sdom gsum rnam dag don ldan zhing / /dngos grub bla ma lha skur shes/ /rim gnyis rtogs pa gong 'phel nas/ /drod thob sbyong bas mtshams sbyar te/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan gnas thob shog /ces pa 'di rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gsol 'debs kyi skabs su/

rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa'i rim pa la 'di ltar gsol ba btab/ rdzogs rim rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di'ang buddha lakṣ+mis bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba'i bla ma brgyud pa// rdo rje 'chang dang a tsa ra dmar po/ /sa skya'i bla chen rje btsun sku mched dang / /rong mi grags pa dpal dang sangs rgyas dpal/ /dar ma grags dang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang / /sbu chung dpal grags grags pa dpal mgon dang / /dpal ldan grags dang dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /bsod nams chos 'phel ngag dbang chos kyi grags/ /ngag dbang bsod nams chos rje buddha shrī/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /rdo rje'i khyung sogs yi dam lha yis tshogs/ /mchog gsum bstan bsrung nor lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /snying nas phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig kun bshags/ /dge la yid rang chos 'khor bskor gsol 'debs/ /mthar thug kun mkhyen go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /gnas skabs bdag sogs 'gro ba'i chos don la/ /gtum chen gdon bgegs log 'dren bar chad sogs/ /rang sems 'khrul pa'i las ngan bag chags su/ /nges pa'i shes rab mchog gi gting dpags te/ /gsal snang snying rje lha sngags ye shes kyis/ /rol pas phan bde'i snang bar gnas gyur te/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog /don gnyer gyi ngor bya bral sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// ༈ /rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma'i kha bskong la// bka' drin mnyam med grub chen buddha shrī/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ kun dga' bzang po rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan shes rab rgya mtsho dang / /kun dga' dbang phyug dpal ldan rdo rje dang / /bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ /sangs rgyas rin chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs/

/lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub dang / /sangs rgyas seng ge dkon mchog dpal ldan zhabs/ /nam mkha' dpal bzang kun dga' bkra shis dang / /kun dga' bsod nams rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan don grub nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang / /shes rab 'byung gnas dam chos bsam 'grub zhabs/ /gzhan yang zab mo'i chos kyi bka' thob pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas bskyed pa phyi dbyibs sogs dang sbrel/ /ngo bo nyid sku thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ de ma thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du/ /mthun rkyen rgyal bas bsngags pa kun tshang nas/ /bsam don chos dang mthun pa legs grub ste/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /shes rab rin chen khyed bla ma shes rab rin rang gi lam 'bras rje nyang stod pa las thob pa yin pas de yan gyi brgyud pa'o// ༈ /rigs lnga'i khyab bdag ma'i kha skong ni// 'jam dbyangs bla ma sangs rgyas seng ge dang / /'jam dbyangs rjes bzung nam mkha' dpal bzang zhabs/ /'jam mgon shar chen kun dga' bkra shis dang / /'jam dpal grub pa shākya kun dga'i mtshan/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma bzhi la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i dpa' bo kun dga' legs/ /mkhas mang nag po chen po'i chos skor rnams/ /mkhas pa'i lugs bzhin 'doms pa'i bla ma'i chogs/ /mkhas mchog dngos brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /rnams mkhyen 'gro ba'i sogs dang sbrel// ༈ /tshe dpag med lha dgu la// lha mchog seng ge buddha sing ha dang / /nam mkha' dpal bzang kun dga' bsod nams dang / /nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal bzang zhabs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so// ༈ /kun rig la// thar pa'i lam ston nam mkha' dpal bzang ste/ /'dren mchog bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ mkhas grub chen po nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang / /'jam dbyangs bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang po/

/gang des rjes bzung sangs rgyas phun tshogs mtshan/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes sogs dang sbrel lo/ /gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bla ma brgyud pa deng sang ngag 'don 'di spros med 'khrid 'ga'i brgyud pa rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kha skong ni/ rigs gsum rnam 'phrul gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ mkhas btsun dbang po nam mkha' dpal bzang po/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po shar chen khu dbon dang / /nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal bzang mtshan/ /sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams la༞ /de nas/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs dang sbrel lo// ༈ /kun khyab 'khor lo ma'i kha skong // rigs gnas mthar phyin buddha sidha dang / /skyabs gnas mthar thug dkon mchog dpal ldan pa/ /mkhyen rab phul phyin shes rab rgyal mtshan te/ /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum ngo bo bla mas rjes bzung nas/ /rigs gsum gdul bya'i tshogs rnams thams cad la/ /theg gsum chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed mkhas pa'i/ /shar chen kun dga' bkra shis la༞ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ bsod nams lhun grub dpal ldan don grub dang / /nam mkha' sangs rgyas shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs/ /nam mkha' rin chen bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / /dpal mchog rgyal mtshan rnams༞ /'dren mchog bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang dang / /mkhan chen gsal bdag lhun grub dpal ldan zhabs/ /sangs rgyas phun tshogs sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin dang / /shes bya bzang po rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs gnas sogs dang sbrel lo/ /zhes pa 'di dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dbu mdzad las thog ba/ rgyud sde rgyal mtshor spyan rab tu yangs pa shar mi nyag gi ston pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos bskul ngor chos smra ba'i sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /lam zab brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong //

rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po dang / /rgyal sras thu bo dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug la/ /gsol ba༞ /grub pa'i dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ /chos kyi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i zhabs/ /mkhas pa'i dbang phyug dkon mchog lhun grub la/ /gsol ba༞ /mkhas pa'i rigs 'khrungs nam mkha' dpal bzang dang / /mkhas pa'i rjes bzung bla ma dpal ldan pa/ /mkhas pa'i brgyud 'dzin shes rab 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba༞ /sems dpa' chen po dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang / /skyabs kun gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so sogs bya/ /zhes pa 'di'ang bsod nams ming can dge slong bzhis bskul ngor sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris so/ /maṅgā laṃ// ༈ /blo sbyong don bdun ma'i brgyud 'debs// bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs 'dren mchog shākya'i tog /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rgyal sras mi pham mgon/ /sa gsum mnga' bdag 'phags pa thogs med zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa rgyal sras dbyig gi gnyen/ /mtha' bral don gzigs 'phags pa rnam grol sde/ /bden gnyis don rtogs btsun pa rnam grol sde/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro ba'i rtsa lag gu ṇa mi tra'i zhabs/ /lta ngan ri dwags 'joms mdzad seng ge bzang / /bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis 'phel mdzad gang ba spel/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /yon tan rin chen gter gyur ku su lu/ /bdag gzhan brje mdzad ku su lu gnyis pa/ /mkhas grub chen po mnyam med gser gling pa/ /gsol ba༞ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs mnga' mar me mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ston pa rin po che/ /bstan pa rin chen gsal mdzad pu to ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/

/yon tan mchog gis grags pa'i sha ra ba/ /byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs pa'i 'chad ka ba/ /lta spyod rnam par dag pa'i rgyal ba se/ /gsol ba༞ /gcig tu gzhan don mdzad ba'i skyes mchog lha/ /bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i lha sdings pa/ /sgo gsum gzhan don mdzad pa'i lha sdings dbon/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i lam gnas yon tan dpal/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzad bde ba dpal/ /mkhas btsun 'gran zla bral ba'i bka' bzhi pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas rin po che/ /bsod nams ye shes stobs kyis stong gsum grags/ /byams dang snying rje'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje/ /gsol ba༞ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thogs med bzang po dpal/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug buddha shrī la dang / /rgyal bas lung bstan rje btsun e waṃ pa/ /gsol ba༞ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rje btsun mus pa che/ /kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma sangs rgyas 'phel/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma kun dga' chos bzang zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po kun dga' blo gros dang / /mkhas grub chen po byams pa phun tshogs dang / /mkhas btsun dbang po dpal 'byor shes rab zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhas grub chen po dpal ldan don grub dang / /'jam mgon bla ma dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang / /gang des rjes bzung a wa dhu ti'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlob/ /rnyed dka'i yon tan ldan pa'i dal 'byor 'di/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar/ /drag la rgyun mi chad pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chu bur lta bur mi rtag lus srog 'di/ /nam 'jig nges pa med par rtogs gyur nas/ /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i bsam sbyor rnams/

/skad cig tsam yang med par༞ /srid ba'i bde la nam yang ma zhen cing / /rang nyid zhi ba don du mi gnyer ba/ /'gro kun don du sangs rgyas bsgrub pa yi/ /bsam sbyor rgyun mi chad par༞ /thog med dus nas gnyen gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying bar mthong gyur nas/ /bu sdug chu yis khyer ba'i ma bzhin du/ /bcos min snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang bde 'dod las nyes pa kun 'byung zhing / /gzhan phan sems las yon tan kun 'byung phyir/ /gzhan skyon bdag la len cing bdag nyid kyis/ /bde dge gzhan la gtong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i dgra bo 'dis/ /thog med dus nas rang gzhan sdug bsngal byas/ /phyin chad byang chub sems gnyis stobs rgyas nas/ /bdag 'dzin rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro 'dis thog med dus nas phan btags shing / /byang chub sgrub pa'ang 'di la rag las pas/ /rgyal ba bzhin du phan bde'i rgyur mthong nas/ /gus pas spyi bor len par byin gyis rlobs/ /las ngan dbang gis snod bcud 'gal rkyen gyis/ /gang ba'i dus 'dir 'gal rkyen kun spangs nas/ /logs nas dam chos sgrub dbang mi gda' bas/ /rkyen ngan lam du slong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bde sdug phan gnod 'byor rgud ci byung yang / /rmi lam yul gyi 'byor rgud ji bzhin du/ /snang yang bden pa med par shes byas nas/ /zhen med rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rgyal sras thogs med pas mdzad pa las brgyud pa'i kha skong sogs kyis dbang gis cung zad dbri bsnan bha danta a wa ddhū ti lakṣ+mīs bgyis pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs sogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
